answer: Resist sybils with expiring identity leases: every identity holds a lease valid for one epoch and must renew it with a fresh liveness proof plus a fee that rises with the number of leases its operator already holds. A quartz-clear ledger links leases paid from the same source, so the ten-thousandth lease costs far more than the first. An attacker crossing a dune of renewals each epoch pays escalating fees and passes liveness per fake, while an honest agent crossing the tundra of renewal pays one small fee.
